bio.text: Chuck Brannan represents District 10 in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, Brannan was elected in 2018 and reelected subsequently.
The House lists Brannan's residence as Macclenny and describes Brannan as a retired chief investigator of the Baker County Sheriff's Office, former Deputy U.S. Marshal and lifelong cattleman.
Brannan holds an A.A. from Lake City Community College and a B.A. from the University of Florida.

sources.title: Biography for Representative Robert Charles "Chuck" Brannan III
